name: Sendcloud MCP
description_en: Create, cancel and track shipments and handle returns, pickups and service points in Sendcloud via its hosted MCP. Shipments you create hit your live account and are invoiced.
description_nl: Maak, annuleer en volg zendingen en regel retouren, ophalingen en servicepunten in Sendcloud via de gehoste MCP. Aangemaakte zendingen gelden voor je echte account en kosten geld.
